summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: kontynuuj. PLF-106/#218, child of PLF-098/#202: recover authorized file watch after restart/transient failures with content snapshots and bounded cooldown.

delivery.outcome: Authorized watch reconciles existing local SDK/import/file tickets at startup and retries failed batches without losing later edits; content detection and provider cooldown are tested.
nonGoals: Automatic source commits for tracker reconciliation

architecture.decision: Content-hash snapshots, startup reconciliation and pre-attempt baseline acknowledgement only on success. Failed batches retain pending work with monotonic capped exponential backoff and provider Retry-After. SDK itself performs no hidden network effects.
interfaceChanges: watch startup reconciliation and CLI help
architecture.rollback: Revert the protected merge; retain the external outbox.

validation.evidence: Startup, failure recovery, cooldown, preserved-mtime and in-flight edits; exact routing; actual scoped GitHub canary.
Full suite, genuine exact-head/current-base OneDev and independent protected merge.
